notes.wavelet: Exact model input has 9 channels: RGB x (LH, HL, HH).
notes.wavelet_display: The overview uses the mean absolute response across the 9 signed detail channels.
notes.dct: dct.npy contains the signed standardized model input; dct_coefficients_raw.npy contains signed coefficients before standardization.
notes.dct_display: dct_log_magnitude.png and the overview show log(1 + abs(raw DCT coefficient)).
notes.hsv: Kornia hue is stored in radians in [0, 2*pi).
notes.visualizations: PNG/PDF files use display mappings; NPY files contain exact tensors.
